name: Memory
summary: Select turns every row into a choice. A 24px checkbox appears at the left and the text indents 40 to make room; the bar becomes Select all and Cancel, and a Delete button counts what is ticked.

looseEnds.title: A memory in two groups ticks in both
looseEnds.detail: “You’ve had a fever since August 14” is checked in Top of mind and again in Current symptoms & conditions, and the count says 3 rather than 4. The tick follows the memory, not the row — so ticking one row ticks its twin, and the count has to deduplicate.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm the count is of memories, not rows, and that ticking one copy ticks the other.

looseEnds.title: The chevron stays on every row
looseEnds.detail: Rows keep the chevron that opens the memory while they are also a checkbox target. Nothing says what a tap on the row body does in this mode — tick, or open.
looseEnds.ask: In selection, does tapping the row tick it, and is the chevron inert or removed?

looseEnds.title: Nothing is drawn with zero ticked
looseEnds.detail: Every selection frame has rows already checked. What the Delete button says and whether it is reachable before anything is ticked is undrawn.
looseEnds.ask: Is Delete hidden, disabled, or does it read “Delete 0 memories”?
